notes.title: Sword and Shield Idle: Developer Gameplay
notes.content: Welcome to the Steam Next Fest live stream for Sword and Shield Idle! Join me, the solo developer, as I showcase the latest features, gameplay strategies, and answer your burning questions in real time. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the game, this event will provide valuable insights and a fun interactive experience. Don’t miss out on the chance to interact with the creator and learn more about the world of Sword and Shield Idle!
